card.name: Digits and links before numbers in results
card.fires_on: Low values on the first digit of a number, an opening parenthesis or dash before a number, and small linking words like "of" or "the" in clinical results and dosing text.

modes.label: Number starts
modes.description: The leading digit or opening bracket just before a figure in rates, percentages, or infusion tables.

modes.label: Linking words in risk statements
modes.description: Small words like "of", "the", or "events" that come before adverse reactions or organ names.
modes.example: higher dosages were associated with a higher rate<< of>> adverse reactions

card.plain: It fires at the spot just before a number or a risk term appears in a results or dosing sentence.
